macros.name: add
macros.doc: \add[a][b]{i}{j} typesets the operation “add the a-fold of row (or column) i to row (or column) j. b is a label for the jth line.

macros.name: colops
macros.doc: To skip to the next section, there are two comands \rowops which swiches to the row operation section, and \colops which switches to the column operation section.

macros.name: labelskip
macros.doc: \labelskip is the distance between an operation arrow and its labels.

macros.name: newmatrix
macros.doc: The \newmatrix command allows to define new matrix environments with special delimiters as described in Section 1.

macros.name: opskip
macros.doc: \opskip is the distance between two consecutive operations.

macros.name: rowaddfromlabel
macros.doc: \rowaddfromlabel is the macro for the label of the from-line of an \add command.

macros.name: rowaddtolabel
macros.doc: \rowaddtolabel fontifies the label of the to-line of an \add command.

macros.name: rowarrowsep
macros.doc: \rowarrowsep denotes the distance from the matrix to the operations.

macros.name: rowmultlabel
macros.doc: \rowmultlabel is the label of a \mult operation in the \rowops section.

macros.name: rowopminsize
macros.doc: The length \rowopminsize is the minimum amount of a horizontal operation segment to go to the right.

macros.name: rowops
macros.doc: To skip to the next section, there are two comands \rowops which swiches to the row operation section, and \colops which switches to the column operation section.

macros.name: rowswapfromlabel
macros.doc: \rowswapfromlabel is the label of a \swap operation in the \rowops section which is to place at the first of the two rows.

macros.name: swap
macros.doc: \swap[a][b]{i}{j} typesets the operation “swap the ith and the jth row (or column)”. a and b are labels to typeset at the end of the arrows, similar to the ·b of the \mult command.
